title: Move the launcher's committed-input helpers out of scripts/test-launcher.mjs into a small module
outcome: scripts/test-launcher.mjs is back toward the architecture lens's ~1,500-line threshold for utility modules; it grew from about 2,011 to 2,183 lines with w-decd61d62831. The pure committed-input helpers (commitInputStatusClean, commitInputNotCleanReason, commitInputOutcome, commitInputSummaryLine and the refuseNotClean builder) move by pure code move into scripts/test-launcher-commit-input.mjs, with a provenance header. createRun and executeRun keep only the call sites, behaviour is unchanged, and scripts/test-launcher-commit-input.test.mjs stays green. Provenance: w-decd fix-delta review, Low (Claude delegation 69811a29).
acceptance: Move the launcher's committed-input helpers out of scripts/test-launcher.mjs into a small module is done
